recommendation_summary: The reply recommends a hosted dead-man heartbeat: one curl line in the cron wrapper pings a hosted check when the job succeeds, and the user gets an email or push alert if that ping is missing for 24 hours.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You asked to know within a day when nightly-sync fails silently, without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: Central log on Synology, Dockerizing the job, Pieter Levels style aggregation.
labels.Bottleneck: The success email is the only signal, so a startup crash before email looks the same as nothing to check.
labels.Checked myself: You told me cron at 03:00 on edna, email on finish, 4-day startup crash on expired token with no email, no other alerting, you will not read logs.

note: The reply recommends a single hosted heartbeat alert, explicitly rejects the Synology log and Docker, and gives all four record lines before the recommendation, each tied to facts from this case.
